title: SAPO: Single-Rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical stage in the post-training of large language models. Existing critic-free, group-relative methods estimate policy advantages from multiple rollouts, avoiding the substantial memory overhead of conventional proximal policy optimization (PPO) and achieving strong performance on long-horizon interactive tasks. Despite their success, recent studies revealed three limitations: (1) Lack explicit value generalization and effective temporal credit assignment; (2) Suffer from potential advantage collapse in long-horizon complex tasks; (3) Require a costly trade-off between sampling budget and policy performance. In this work, we propose Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization (SAPO), a low-memory and compute-efficient framework in which the policy and value functions share a single autoregressive backbone. translated_title: SAPO：用于智能体强化学习的单次 rollout 自回归策略优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19842v1 公告类型：新公告  摘要：智能体强化学习（RL）已成为大型语言模型后训练中的关键阶段。现有的无评论家、基于组相对的方法通过多次 rollout 估计策略优势，避免了传统近端策略优化（PPO）的大量内存开销，并在长时程交互任务上取得了强劲性能。尽管这些方法取得了成功，但近期研究揭示了三个局限性：（1）缺乏显式的价值泛化和有效的时间信用分配；（2）在长时程复杂任务中可能遭遇优势崩溃；（3）需要在采样预算和策略性能之间进行昂贵的权衡。在这项工作中，我们提出了单次 rollout 自回归策略优化（SAPO），这是一种低内存且计算高效的框架，其中策略和价值函数共享一个单一的自回归主干。SAPO 利用 LLM 的自回归结构来生成策略和价值。
tldr: SAPO 提出了一种共享自回归主干的单次 rollout 框架，通过同时生成策略和价值函数，解决了现有方法在价值泛化、优势崩溃和采样效率方面的不足，实现了低内存和高效的计算。
en_tdlr: SAPO introduces a single-rollout framework with a shared autoregressive backbone that jointly generates policy and value functions, addressing limitations in value generalization, advantage collapse, and sampling efficiency for low-memory, compute-efficient agentic RL.
